About TableCopy

Making web data extraction simple, fast, and privacy-focused

Our Mission

At TableCopy, we believe that extracting data from the web should be simple, fast, and secure. Our mission is to empower professionals, students, and businesses with tools that make web data accessible without compromising privacy or requiring technical expertise.

What We Do

TableCopy provides a suite of lightweight, browser-based tools that help you convert web tables into Excel, PDF, images, Word documents, and more. Our flagship tool copies web tables to Excel with perfect formatting, saving you hours of manual work.

Unlike traditional solutions that require software installation or send your data to external servers, all TableCopy tools run entirely in your browser. Your data never leaves your device, ensuring complete privacy and security.

Our Values

Privacy First

We don't collect, store, or transmit your data. All processing happens locally in your browser, giving you complete control over your information.

User-Focused Design

Our tools are designed by data professionals who understand your pain points. We prioritize simplicity, efficiency, and reliability in everything we build.

Continuous Improvement

We're constantly updating our tools based on user feedback and evolving web technologies to ensure you always have the best data extraction experience.

Our Story

TableCopy was born from frustration. As data professionals with over 15 years of experience in web scraping and data analysis, we struggled daily with broken formatting, missing data, and hours of cleanup work when converting web tables to Excel. We tested every method available—manual copy-paste, Excel web queries, Python scripts, and countless browser extensions. Each approach failed to deliver the simplicity and reliability we needed. So we built TableCopy, a tool that combines enterprise-grade accuracy with consumer-level simplicity. Today, TableCopy is trusted by financial analysts, researchers, e-commerce managers, and students worldwide to extract web data efficiently and securely.
